description: This local weather station is an autonomous environmental monitoring system powered by an ESP32 microcontroller, which collects real-time physical data on temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure using specialized sensors like the DHT22 and BMP280.
summary: A weather station powered by a ESP-32 Microcontroller. It is a solution that collects data from the weather, like temperature, humidity and atmospheric pressure using dedicated sensors like BMP28O, DHT22 and internet sources.
details: Teresian-Climate is a weather station that mixes real sensor data with online weather information. We built it using an ESP32 board, a DHT22 sensor, a BMP280 sensor, and a small OLED screen. We coded the board in C++ using the Arduino IDE to measure temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure where we are, and we also connected internet sources to get extra weather details. All of this information is shown on a simple website we made with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Our goal is to make an easy tool that helps students and our community check daily weather and learn about weather changes.
